"""
threaded_lru_cache.py

A thread-safe LRU cache with per-entry TTL (time-to-live) expiry.

Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (safe for nested operations).
- LRU eviction when maxsize is exceeded.
- Per-entry TTL expiry (entries expire individually based on insertion time).
- Optional per-call TTL override.
- Full type hints and docstrings.
- Statistics tracking (hits, misses, evictions, expirations).
- `get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear`, `contains`, `size` operations.
- Decorator factory `lru_cache_with_ttl` mirroring functools.lru_cache usage.

Requires Python 3.9+ (uses dict ordering and modern typing).
"""
